title: QBI deduction and S-corp salary optimization
summary: Same Section 199A logic as contractors. SSTB phase-outs create hard income cliffs for many professional services businesses.
detailsHtml: The interaction between salary, distributions, retirement contributions, and QBI deduction is one of the most complex tax-planning problems in U.S. small business. The basic conflict: higher W-2 wages support higher retirement contributions but reduce QBI-eligible income; lower wages preserve QBI but limit retirement contributions. Professional tax software or a knowledgeable CPA models all of this simultaneously; doing it by hand is error-prone.
